title: thelypteris austrophilippina
intro: Thelypteris austrophilippina, commonly known as the Mountain Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its distinctive frond structure. The health benefits of Thelypteris austrophilippina are primarily attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The bioactive constituents of the Mountain Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are known for their therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects.
